title: RunTheCase Thread Map
description: The overarching mystery: villain, antagonist network, hidden breadcrumbs, and cross-case callbacks. Authors' data — drives flag-setting per ENGINE-SPEC §5, never shown verbatim to the player.

inside_man_id.description: ref -> characters.json id. The recurring character who is eventually revealed as the villain's mole. Internal only.

breadcrumbs.description: Hidden thread clues scattered across cases. Each corresponds to evidence with is_clue:false + this tag in some case's evidence[].thread_tag.

case_id.description: ref -> the case this breadcrumb first appears in

surfaces.description: What this breadcrumb quietly establishes, for authors only

callbacks.description: Cross-case references (a later case's staging/evidence explicitly echoes an earlier one).
